topic: How do on-board storage constraints influence payload power allocation between immediate and time-tagged service prioritization?
consensus_response: Onboard storage constraints directly impact payload power allocation, necessitating prioritization between time-tagged (critical) and immediate services. This leads to increased interference as higher priority services demand more frequent uploads, requiring adaptive modulation techniques for efficient data transmission and minimized interference.  Dynamic modulation techniques adapt order based on signal strength and interference levels to optimize performance under constrained environments.
